description: what the bundled interface is allowed to do. The window loads a static export of apps/web from inside the bundle, so this capability is local: it carries no `remote.urls` block and no remote origin inherits it. Window control is enumerated command by command because the frameless window has no system frame to fall back on: start-dragging is the title bar's drag region, minimize / toggle-maximize / close are its buttons, maximize is the `start maximized` setting, set-always-on-top and set-min-size are the other two window settings, and restore-state is the `remember size and position` switch asking the window-state plugin to put the window back. Size and position are never set from the page — the plugin owns the geometry — so those two commands are not granted. Also here: opening links in the system browser, the folder picker and the app data directory; the local files themselves are read through the local_* commands, and the granted root is added to the asset protocol scope at runtime (there is no static $ROOT to write here).
